description: Count the subscribers who currently match a saved segment's rules. Returns count and the segmentId that was counted; it does not list the subscribers (use search_subscribers with segmentId for that).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

segmentId.description: Saved segment to count, from list_segments.

name: get_segment_count

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_segment_count` MCP tool.

count.description: Number of subscribers matching the segment.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
